sources.title: 49 CFR Part 1572 — TWIC
sources.source_type: webpage saved as PDF / federal regulation
sources.notes: Core federal source for TWIC credentialing and security threat assessment rules. Saved manually as PDF from the official eCFR page. Wayback capture was attempted, but Internet Archive archived an eCFR/Federal Register unblock page instead of the regulation content, so no Wayback URL is recorded.

sources.title: PANYNJ Marine Terminal Tariff PA-10 (effective May 1, 2026)
sources.notes: Primary current Port Authority tariff. States 'Effective: May 1st, 2026' on its pages. Governs DTR registration and drayage-truck gate access (Subrules 34-1060, 34-1080, 34-1101, 34-1121, 34-1140). Added to curated metadata 2026-07-16; previously recorded only in data/raw/metadata.json. Original URL is the tariffs landing page; the exact document URL was not recorded at pull time.

metadata_roles: data/raw/metadata.json is the checksum inventory (file sizes and SHA-256 for every archived raw file); data/metadata.json (this file) is the curated provenance log (exact URLs, Wayback snapshots, mutability, pulled dates). Both must list every raw source; discrepancies are audit findings.
